children: Caesars Entertainment voluntarily supplements its definitive proxy to disclose Latham & Watkins’ separate representations of Fertitta affiliates while denying any required additional disclosure.
Received a Section 220 demand seeking books and records alleging omitted disclosures about Latham & Watkins’ concurrent representations.
Caesars says claims are without merit and immaterial but will supplement the definitive proxy to avoid delay or added litigation risk to the merger.
Latham represents Caesars on the merger; a separate Latham team represents Tilman Fertitta and affiliates in unrelated matters with materially smaller fees.
Company reiterates investors should read the definitive proxy and other SEC filings for participant identities, interests, and voting decisions.
